site.name: Gelian
site.tagline: A vessel for Ceylon value, carried to the world.
site.description: Gelian is a privately held investment vehicle. We identify distinctive Sri Lankan value, shape it into disciplined brands and businesses, and carry it to global markets — while bringing capital, standards and opportunity back in return.
site.mission: Carrying distinctive Ceylon value outward, and bringing the world's capital and standards home.
site.legalNote: Gelian is a privately held investment and holding vehicle. It deploys its own and its principals' capital to originate, build and hold businesses, and does not manage pooled outside capital or operate as a collective investment scheme. Nothing on this website is an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any security, and nothing here should be read as investment, legal or tax advice.

contact.responseTime: We reply to every serious enquiry within three working days.
